en: Black‑and‑white street scene of a European town square with cobblestone pavement. In the center stands a rectangular stone fountain with a decorative column and statue. Surrounding the square are 3‑ to 4‑story masonry buildings with steep tiled roofs and dormer windows. The corner building on the right has a large sign reading "Apotheke." (pharmacy), while the corner building on the left has a shop sign "Alwin Eggler." People in early 20th‑century clothing walk or stand around; a horse‑drawn wagon is visible at the right edge. The overall look is that of a historical German small town or city square.
